# Phase Two — Twenty Concrete Improvements

1. Make reconciliation observation read-only under the same Wallet lock.
2. Detect stale reserved credits separately from execution mismatch.
3. Treat succeeded/already-owned release as a valid deduplicated terminal topology.
4. Strip account IDs, reservation IDs, execution IDs, provider results, and private payloads from health output.
5. Expose health only through authenticated current-account identity unless a real admin role exists.
6. Prefer text/HTML health output if serialization constraints forbid new JSON output.
7. Test missing reservations and contradictory terminal states.
8. Keep reconciliation aggregation in focused sibling modules.
9. Profile startup by module load rather than guessing at database latency.
10. Lazy-load only optional DosDB subsystems proven unnecessary for basic DB initialization.
11. Preserve required DB/auth readiness before HTTP bind.
12. Re-run isolated startup measurement after any lazy-load refactor.
13. Reuse existing share/export/import route/query conventions for cross-product handoff.
14. Keep handoff payloads small, typed, URL-safe, and non-secret.
15. Degrade gracefully if a target product is absent.
16. Verify focus-visible, reduced-motion, high-contrast, touch-size, and overflow on shared UI.
17. Keep games non-pay-to-win; monetize cosmetics/content/convenience/creator value only.
18. Add premium value only where a real server handler can fulfill it.
19. Re-run generated catalog/sitemap freshness after shared route changes.
20. Preserve explicit continuation ledgers for anything honestly unfinished.
